tickets.title: Verify tools, device and capacity
acceptance: Record editor choices, device route and unresolved setup facts.

tickets.title: Create pinned project and empty device build
acceptance: A development build opens on Android and desktop.

tickets.title: Import C1 narrative and stable IDs
acceptance: All required slice lines and IDs load; missing IDs produce useful errors.

tickets.title: Shared select/confirm input and hotspots
acceptance: Touch and mouse share actions; duplicate taps do not double-act.

tickets.title: Dialogue, choices and transcript
acceptance: C1S2 can be read, paused and reviewed without skipped choices.

tickets.title: Authoritative session and command commits
acceptance: Rejected commands do not mutate state; successful commands commit once.

tickets.title: Combined checkpoint and last-good recovery
acceptance: Resume preserves matching world and narrative state after termination.

tickets.title: Reflection and complete P02
acceptance: Observe old catch, return and open present cabinet; no cross-era object action.

tickets.title: Radio interaction P01
acceptance: Radio can be solved or assisted with progress preserved.

tickets.title: Graybox opening scene views
acceptance: Required targets and poses are readable on the phone.

tickets.title: Integrate all four opening scenes
acceptance: The functional opening plays from start to completion.

tickets.title: Text, captions, two hints and Show next step
acceptance: Complete with muted audio, largest text, discrete controls and Show next step assistance.

tickets.title: Temporary audio and controls
acceptance: Audio pause/resume works and muting loses no information.

tickets.title: Android profile and layout pass
acceptance: Device frame, memory and load measurements are recorded.

tickets.title: Interruption and repeated-command hardening
acceptance: Restart at each critical transition creates no duplicate grants or contradictions.

tickets.title: Observed playtests and revision
acceptance: Comprehension, attention and duration observations support a recorded next decision.

tickets.title: Representative art/audio subsection
acceptance: Five-to-eight minutes reach target quality with measured production effort.

tickets.title: iOS feasibility on Mac and iPhone
acceptance: Physical iPhone build passes input and save tests; prerequisite access documented.

tickets.title: Plain presentation ending integration harness
acceptance: Every ending preview/confirm/cancel/restart path preserves a single committed outcome.

tickets.title: Measured scope and cash re-estimate
acceptance: Update scope, dates and cash assumptions before volume production.

tickets.title: Integrate chapters 2 and 3
acceptance: Chapters complete with reused systems and external observations.

tickets.title: Integrate chapters 4 and 5
acceptance: Chapters complete without one-off general frameworks.

tickets.title: Complete chapters 6 and 7
acceptance: Full start-to-ending alpha works for all three outcomes.

tickets.title: Release-candidate preparation
acceptance: Devices, accessibility, content, licensing and store readiness reviewed.
